I work at [Samriddhi Foundation](https://samriddhi.org/), where our team studies how state capacity, regulatory complexity, and beliefs shape corruption outcomes. My work includes designing the study and its causal identification strategy, reviewing the literature, and analysing data.

My research interests are **causal inference**, **development economics**, and **political economy**. My current and past work covers caste-based wage gaps, gender norms and female labour force participation, the political economy of conflict in Nepal, and health financing.

Eventually, I hope to pursue a PhD in Economics and return to work in academia in Nepal.
